name: 乾燥症
intro: 這頁整理乾燥症的日常保健：照顧眼睛與口腔、留意可能讓口乾的藥、面對疲倦，以及何時該盡早回診。

cards.title: 照顧眼睛
cards.summary: 規律點人工淚液、熱敷眼皮，並避開乾燥環境。
cards.illustration: A calm adult at home tilting the head back to put in eye drops, with a warm compress resting on a nearby table and a closed laptop to the side; flat, friendly style, no text, no brands.

points.text: 規律點不含防腐劑的人工淚液，例如每 2 到 3 小時一次。

evidence.quote: Advise regular use of a preservative free lubricating eye drop (e.g. 2–3 hourly) (1, A) (SOA 94.4%).

Always prescribe preservative free drops. … They concluded that individuals should be offered non-preserved or soft preserved eye drops to avoid worsening of the dry-eye disease due to the toxic, proinflammatory and detergent effects of the preservative

points.text: 睡前可塗潤滑眼藥膏，幫助夜間緩解乾眼；它會讓視線模糊，所以多在睡前使用。

evidence.quote: Ophthalmic ointments are thicker than AT and may be used to provide symptom control overnight; they are typically used before bedtime because they produce blurred vision and their use should be followed by morning lid hygiene to prevent blepharitis.
In general, most of us treating patients with SD associated dry eye would start with a sodium hyaluronate–containing drop during the day and an eye ointment at night
evidence.strength: Expert practice statement; not a graded recommendation

points.text: 每天熱敷眼皮至少 10 分鐘，有助改善眼皮油脂腺（瞼板腺）功能不良；溫度以溫熱不燙為原則。

evidence.quote: Advise a heated eyelid compress for at least 10 min daily (1, A) (SOA 94.9%).

evidence.strength: Editorial safety phrase 「溫度以溫熱不燙為原則」; not from a source

points.text: 盡量避開過熱或乾燥的環境，避免風直接吹到眼睛，以免淚水蒸發太快。
points.strength_label: BSR 2025・指引說明；巴西風濕病學會 2015・建議強度 D

evidence.quote: Low humidity speeds up evaporation of tears and where possible individuals should avoid overheated and air-conditioned environments.

To prevent tear evaporation, the patient must avoid dry environments, air conditioning, wind, and also activities that decrease eye blinking, such as using the computer or reading for a long period of time.
evidence.strength: Table 1 general measure; linked recommendation grade D

points.text: 長時間看螢幕或閱讀時，記得眨眼，並定時休息。

evidence.quote: … the patient must avoid … activities that decrease eye blinking, such as using the computer or reading for a long period of time.
evidence.strength: Table 1 general measure; linked recommendation grade D

evidence.quote: Improving blinking, optimizing the work environment and encouraging regular breaks may help.

tip.text: 塗過眼藥膏的隔天早上，記得清潔眼皮，可預防眼瞼炎。

evidence.quote: … their use should be followed by morning lid hygiene to prevent blepharitis.

cards.title: 照顧口腔與牙齒
cards.summary: 用含氟產品護牙，並依唾液多寡選擇緩解方法。
cards.illustration: An adult brushing teeth at a bathroom sink, with a glass of water and a plain pack of chewing gum on the counter; flat, friendly style, no text, no brands.

points.text: 有口乾的人，都應使用含氟產品來預防蛀牙。

evidence.quote: Final recommendations for patients with Sjögren disease with dry mouth were as follows: topical fluoride should be used in all patients (strong)

points.text: 規律用含氟牙膏刷牙、主動看牙醫，並用含木糖醇的產品代替糖。

evidence.quote: Recommend regular brushing with fluoride toothpaste, proactive dental care and the use of xylitol containing products as an alternative to sugar to prevent dental decay (2, C) (SOA 95.6%).

points.text: 還有一些唾液的人，可嚼無糖口香糖或使用無糖含片，刺激唾液分泌。

evidence.quote: using gustatory stimulants (sugar-free acidic candies, lozenges, xylitol) and/or mechanical stimulants (sugar-free chewing gum) … since, in these patients, glandular function can be stimulated
Chewing gum was associated with increased saliva production in the majority of those with residual capacity but there was no evidence that gum was more or less effective than saliva substitutes.

although no study results link improved salivary flow to caries prevention, the oral health community generally accepts that increasing saliva may contribute to decreased caries incidence, so increasing saliva through gustatory, masticatory, or pharmaceutical stimulation may be considered (weak)
For example, sugar-free lozenges and/or chewing gum, xylitol, mannitol, …

points.text: 可用人工唾液緩解口乾；唾液很少或幾乎沒有的人，人工唾液是主要的緩解方法。

evidence.quote: Suggest saliva substitutes for symptomatic relief of oral dryness (2, C) (SOA 93.3%).
… preferred therapeutic approach to alleviate symptoms in patients with no residual glandular function
The preferred first therapeutic approach for oral dryness according to salivary gland function may be: … saliva substitution for severe dysfunction (LoE 1a/*1b, LoA 8.7)
evidence.strength: LoE 1a (*1b for pharmacological stimulation); LoA 8.7; GoR not found

points.text: 經常補充水分，最好是喝白開水。
points.strength_label: 巴西風濕病學會 2015・建議強度 D

evidence.quote: SS patients should be encouraged to drink fluids frequently, preferably water.

cards.title: 可能讓口乾的藥
cards.summary: 有些藥物可能造成口乾，或讓乾眼更嚴重。
cards.illustration: A patient and a doctor sitting at a desk, looking over several plain, unlabeled medicine boxes together; flat, friendly style, no text, no brands.

points.text: 有些藥物可能造成口乾，也可能讓乾眼更嚴重。
points.strength_label: Wolff 2017・研究顯示；TFOS DEWS III 2025・指引說明

evidence.quote: Among the 94 subgroups under the second level, 26 contain agents were reported to be associated with SGD, with 22 having strong evidence, …
Systemic medications can also exacerbate DED through different mechanisms, including anticholinergic effects (antihistamines, antidepressants) or glandular atrophy (isotretinoin).
Elimination of offending systemic medication

points.text: 可能造成口乾的藥，包括部分降血壓藥、利尿劑、抗組織胺（過敏藥）、止吐藥和肌肉鬆弛劑。

evidence.quote: Among the 94 subgroups under the second level, 26 contain agents were reported to be associated with SGD, with 22 having strong evidence, namely drugs for functional gastrointestinal disorders, anti-emetics and anti-nauseants, anti-obesity preparations, anti-hypertensives, diuretics, beta-blocking agents, calcium channel blockers, urologicals, anti-neoplastic agents, muscle relaxants, drugs for the treatment of bone diseases, analgesics, anti-epileptics, anti-Parkinson drugs, psycholeptics, psychoanaleptics, other nervous system drugs, anti-muscarinic drugs for obstructive airway diseases, anti-histamines for systemic use, and ophthalmologicals.

points.text: 某些精神科用藥（如抗憂鬱藥）、抗癲癇藥、抗巴金森藥和泌尿科用藥，也可能造成口乾。

evidence.quote: Among the 94 subgroups under the second level, 26 contain agents were reported to be associated with SGD, with 22 having strong evidence, namely drugs for functional gastrointestinal disorders, anti-emetics and anti-nauseants, anti-obesity preparations, anti-hypertensives, diuretics, beta-blocking agents, calcium channel blockers, urologicals, anti-neoplastic agents, muscle relaxants, drugs for the treatment of bone diseases, analgesics, anti-epileptics, anti-Parkinson drugs, psycholeptics, psychoanaleptics, other nervous system drugs, anti-muscarinic drugs for obstructive airway diseases, anti-histamines for systemic use, and ophthalmologicals.
Systemic medications can also exacerbate DED through different mechanisms, including anticholinergic effects (antihistamines, antidepressants) or glandular atrophy (isotretinoin).

points.text: 醫師有時可以換藥、減量或停用造成口乾的藥。

evidence.quote: Management strategies include substitution or discontinuation of medications whenever possible, oral or systemic therapy with sialogogues, administration of saliva substitutes, and use of electro-stimulating devices. … Other management options for MISGD include possibly reducing the number of medications or the dosage or replacing them with medications or formulations with fewer xerogenic effects. Little evidence is available on this important topic;
Elimination of offending systemic medication

tip.text: 用藥調整請和醫師討論，不要自行停藥。

cards.title: 疲倦與運動
cards.summary: 安排好活動步調，運動也可能減輕疲倦。
cards.illustration: An adult doing gentle exercise outdoors, and the same person resting on a bench with a simple weekly planner; flat, friendly style, no text, no brands.

points.text: 疲倦時，可和醫療團隊一起檢視活動安排、睡眠品質與生活習慣。

evidence.quote: We recommend an individualized holistic review for those with fatigue focusing on activity management (for example planning, prioritizing, pacing), sleep quality and lifestyle (2, C) (SOA 96.7%).

points.text: 安排活動時，先規劃、排出優先順序，並調整步調。

evidence.quote: … focusing on activity management (for example planning, prioritizing, pacing) …

points.text: 運動對乾燥症患者是安全的，也可能幫助減輕疲倦。

evidence.quote: Exercise is safe and potentially beneficial for those with SD and fatigue (2, C) (SOA 97.9%). … Overall exercise appears beneficial for fatigue in SD but there is insufficient evidence to recommend one type of exercise over another.
Key recommendations include … use of self-care measures and advice regarding exercise to reduce fatigue
Education about self care measures SHOULD include advice about exercise to reduce fatigue in Sjögren's.

points.text: 保持身體活動、做有氧運動，副作用少，也可能減輕疼痛、改善身體功能。

evidence.quote: physical activity and aerobic exercise are interventions with few adverse events that may reduce pain severity and improve physical function

myths.fact: 針灸能否改善乾燥症的口乾，目前證據不足：研究回顧中的針灸研究，對象是放射治療後口乾的人，效果和假針灸沒有差別（證據品質低）；乾燥症病人的試驗結果則不一致。

evidence.quote: found low quality evidence that acupuncture is no different from placebo
concluded that acupuncture was no different from placebo
Five small studies (total 153 participants, with dry mouth following radiotherapy treatment) compared acupuncture with placebo.
There is low quality evidence that acupuncture is no different from placebo acupuncture with regard to dry mouth symptoms, which is the most important outcome.
The use of other treatment modalities cannot be supported on the basis of current evidence.
In patients with primary Sjögren's syndrome, acupuncture did not satisfactorily improve symptoms compared to placebo.
The acupuncture group exhibited significant improvement in total ESSPRI and ESSPRI dryness scores.

Compared with the control group, the treatment group had significantly lower ESSPRI scores, eye dryness NRS, and mouth dryness NRS and significantly higher salivary flow rates, Schirmer test results, and BUT scores (all P<0.05)
evidence.strength: RCT (n=138, sham-controlled, both arms on hydroxychloroquine)

myths.belief: 戴抗藍光眼鏡，可以預防看螢幕造成的眼睛不適。
myths.fact: 依目前最佳證據，抗藍光的方法看來不是有效的處理方式；記得眨眼、定時休息可能有幫助。

evidence.quote: Based on current, best evidence, blue-light blocking interventions do not appear to be an effective management strategy.
Improving blinking, optimizing the work environment and encouraging regular breaks may help.

myths.belief: 吃 DHEA 補充劑可以改善乾燥症的疲倦。
myths.fact: 研究回顧（5 項研究、共 240 名女性）發現，DHEA 改善疲倦的效果和安慰劑沒有差別。

evidence.quote: In SS, the five studies encompassed 240 individuals, all females, and showed modest results.(). Some improvement in dryness, fatigue, and quality of life was observed without differences compared to placebo. … General symptoms such as fatigue and feeling of well-being did not change in SS or FM patients. … results in RA, FM, and SS are disappointing.
evidence.strength: Tier 2 systematic review (no meta-analysis); not graded. The row's 'STRONG (against)' belongs to S24.

evidence.quote: DHEA is NOT RECOMMENDED for treatment of fatigue in Sjögren's.

seek_care.text: 唾液腺出現新的腫脹，或腫脹持續不消時，請盡早回診。

evidence.quote: Individuals with SD should be offered further investigation early if they present with new salivary gland swelling or other symptoms that might suggest the development of lymphoma (1, A) (SOA 98.75%).
Known risk factors include persistent salivary gland swelling, vasculitis and palpable purpura, lymphadenopathy, …

seek_care.text: 出現持續夜間盜汗、發燒，或 3 個月內體重減輕 10% 以上，請盡早回診。

evidence.quote: Individuals with SD should be offered further investigation early if they present with … other symptoms that might suggest the development of lymphoma (1, A) (SOA 98.75%).

In addition, clinical signs and symptoms associated with lymphoma should alert to the possible existence of early/microscopic NHL. These include B symptoms (persistent night sweats, fevers and weight loss of ≥10% over the preceding 3 months), clonal lymphocytosis in peripheral blood flow cytometry and splenomegaly.
